# Fetch all habit log notes (1971-1993) and extract date and ate_homemade_meals status.
note_ids = list(range(1971, 1994))  # 1971 to 1993 inclusive
notes_data = []
for note_id in note_ids:
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=access_token)
    title = note.get('title', '')
    content = note.get('content', '')
    # Extract date from title like "Habit Log -- 2023-04-27"
    date_str = title.split('--')[-1].strip() if '--' in title else None
    # Extract ate_homemade_meals value from content
    ate_homemade = None
    for line in content.splitlines():
        if line.strip().startswith('ate_homemade_meals:'):
            ate_homemade = line.split(':')[-1].strip().lower()
            break
    if date_str and ate_homemade:
        notes_data.append({'date': date_str, 'ate_homemade_meals': ate_homemade})
    else:
        print(f"Warning: Could not parse note {note_id}")

# Sort by date
notes_data.sort(key=lambda x: x['date'])
print("Parsed notes (date, ate_homemade_meals):")
for n in notes_data:
    print(n['date'], n['ate_homemade_meals'])

# Compute the longest consecutive streak of "yes" for ate_homemade_meals.
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

max_streak = 0
current_streak = 0
prev_date = None

for entry in notes_data:
    date = datetime.strptime(entry['date'], '%Y-%m-%d')
    is_yes = entry['ate_homemade_meals'] == 'yes'
    
    if is_yes:
        # Check if this date is consecutive to previous date (if any)
        if prev_date is not None and (date - prev_date).days == 1:
            current_streak += 1
        else:
            # Either first yes or gap in dates, start new streak
            current_streak = 1
    else:
        # Reset streak on "no"
        current_streak = 0
    
    if current_streak > max_streak:
        max_streak = current_streak
    
    prev_date = date

print(f"Longest ate-homemade-meals streak: {max_streak} days")
